title: Xanthe and the Horizon
premise: Jude Quintana, estranged son of a disgraced archaeologist, has spent years digging for other people's fortunes while dodging his father's name. When dying prospector Elias Vane trades him a hand-drawn map to the Sunken Vault of Kesh-Tamar for a promise — that whatever is found goes to the glacier village that sheltered Elias, not to collectors — Jude inherits both the debt and the destination. Racing a monsoon downriver and up the icefields, he must repair a leaking boat with the help of Mara Oduya, a river pilot who knew his father, before calving season opens the ice route for only days. At the vault, Jude finds his father's final field notes among the treasures and must choose between selling the discovery to clear his debts or honoring the promise; he chooses the promise, burying the vault's location in the village's keeping, and finally belongs somewhere.
about_author: Ines Eastwick is a former river guide who spent six seasons in high-altitude survey camps before turning to fiction. She writes adventure stories about people who inherit more than they bargained for.

chapters.title: The Weight of Borrowed Shovels
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Digging a collector's trench in the lowlands, Jude is recognized by his father's surname and thrown off the site, deepening his debt to the crew boss. Emotional beat: resentment of an inherited name.

chapters.title: A Map for a Promise
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. In a port tavern he finds Elias Vane dying of fever; the old prospector offers his map to the Sunken Vault if Jude swears the find belongs to the glacier village of Tsering. Jude swears, half-believing. Beat: reluctant obligation kindled into curiosity.

chapters.title: What the Compass Remembers
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Examining the compass his father left him, Jude realizes its markings match Elias's map — his father searched for the same vault. Flashbacks to their estrangement. Beat: grief surfacing through anger.

chapters.title: Downstream Before the Rain
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. He buys a cheap, leaking riverboat and departs ahead of the monsoon, pursued by crew boss Harken, who wants the map as debt payment. Beat: flight with purpose.

chapters.title: The Pilot at Kiln Landing
chapters.summary: Mara Oduya's POV. River pilot Mara refuses Jude's fare until she sees the compass and recognizes it from her past partnership with his father. She signs on, hiding why. Beat: guarded alliance formed over shared history.

chapters.title: Monsoon Rising
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. The storm catches them mid-river; the boat takes on water faster than the bilge can manage. They bail through the night, bailing out secrets too. Beat: forced trust under pressure.

chapters.title: Repairs at the Drowned Church
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. They beach at a flooded ruin to patch the hull; Mara reveals his father once saved her brother and then vanished owing her answers. Jude learns his father wasn't only a fraud. Beat: the myth of the father cracks open.

chapters.title: Harken's Wake
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Harken's gunboat overtakes them; Mara runs the rapids to escape, nearly losing the boat and each other's confidence. Beat: loyalty tested by speed and fear.

chapters.title: The Village Under the Glacier
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. They reach Tsering, where elders confirm Elias's promise and show them carvings matching the map. The villagers treat Jude as expected kin, unsettling him. Beat: belonging offered before it's earned.

chapters.title: Calving Season Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The ice route opens in nine days and closes fast; supplies are short and Harken is buying porters upstream. They plan the ascent. Beat: ticking clock established.

chapters.title: Lessons in Ice
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. A village guide teaches crevasse rescue; Jude fails publicly, then saves a child's goat from a melt channel, earning quiet respect. Beat: competence rebuilt from humility.

chapters.title: The Betrayal at Basecamp
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. A porter sells their route to Harken; the camp scatters in a night storm. Mara accuses Jude of leading trouble to the village. Beat: alliance fractures.

chapters.title: Alone on the White Stair
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Jude climbs alone toward the ice gate, confronting memories of his father's last letter, which he never opened. He reads it at altitude: an apology and coordinates. Beat: forgiveness begins with the dead.

chapters.title: The Gate Opens
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The glacier calves spectacularly, opening the route for days. Mara, unable to let Jude die alone, follows with two loyal villagers. Beat: choice over grievance.

chapters.title: Descent to the Sunken Vault
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Inside the ice tunnel they find the vault: treasure beyond price — and his father's field kit, proving he found it first and sealed it to protect the valley. Beat: the father redeemed posthumously.

chapters.title: Harken at the Threshold
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Harken arrives with hired men; a standoff in the collapsing ice corridor turns deadly when the vault begins to flood with meltwater. Beat: climax ignites.

chapters.title: What Cannot Be Carried
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Jude could take enough gold to erase his debt but instead triggers the ancient seal, flooding the approach as they escape, trapping Harken's greed behind ice. Beat: sacrifice as inheritance.

chapters.title: The Long Way Down
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The descent, injured and empty-handed, carrying only notes and Elias's map. One villager doesn't survive; grief binds the survivors. Beat: cost acknowledged honestly.

chapters.title: Debts and Ledgers
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Back in Tsering, Jude settles his original debt by honest labor and gives Elias's map to the village elders for safekeeping. Beat: promises kept, identity rewritten.

chapters.title: The Collector's Offer
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. A museum agent offers Jude a fortune just to consult on the vault's likely location. He declines, offering instead his father's legitimate field notes. Beat: temptation refused without bitterness.

chapters.title: First Frost, First Season
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Mara stays the winter; she and Jude plan a survey school for village youth, teaching reading of rivers and ice. Beat: love and vocation taking root quietly.

chapters.title: Xanthe and the Horizon
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Spring: the horizon opens as the ice retreats. Jude names the sealed vault after Elias, sets his father's compass to true north, and stays. Final beat: belonging chosen, memory honored, inheritance passed forward.
